title: 🔆🔅Bandar Anzali Mourns Sailor Nima Moradi as Body Returns After Caspian Sea Attack
text:
🔆🔅Bandar Anzali Mourns Sailor Nima Moradi as Body Returns After Caspian Sea Attack"

""
"Last night, the people of Bandar Anzali county bid a solemn farewell to the body of sailor Nima Moradi (23 years old) during their 154th nightly gathering at Imam Khomeini Square. Moradi was martyred in a Ukrainian attack on a commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea."

"The remains of Martyr Nima Moradi, one of the victims of the attack on the merchant ship "Anna," arrived in the province on Sunday evening via Sardar Jangal Rasht International Airport. The ceremony was attended by the Governor of Gilan, a group of provincial officials, families of esteemed martyrs, and various segments of the public.
